sources.name: City of Northglenn Recreation – Sports
sources.reason: Northglenn is next to Westminster. The city runs youth and adult sports all year, including co-ed youth basketball leagues with the Denver Nuggets in winter, spring and fall.

sources.name: Northglenn Recreation – Youth Basketball League (Junior Nuggets)
sources.reason: Northglenn's official league page for grades 1–8, split into 1/2, 3/4, 5/6 and 7/8. Players practice once a week. Check here for season signups.

sources.name: Denver Museum of Nature & Science – Science Camps
sources.reason: Lists the museum's camps for fall, winter, spring and summer school breaks, with registration dates.

sources.name: Denver Zoo – Safari Camps
sources.reason: Full-day camps for kids in kindergarten through grade 4 on school breaks and in summer. Members get to register earlier than non-members.

sources.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro Denver – Summer Camp
sources.reason: Low-cost summer camp across metro Denver with nature activities and field trips. One $50 fee covers the whole household for the summer.

sources.name: CSU Spur (Denver) – Camps
sources.reason: Free summer camps at CSU Spur and Johnson Recreation Center. Students who live or go to school in zip code 80216 get priority. There is an interest form for 2027.

sources.name: MSU Denver – Summer Camps
sources.reason: University summer camps in sports (basketball, soccer) and in aerospace and computing.

sources.name: Colorado Mountain Club – Youth Winter Camps
sources.reason: One-day outdoor winter camps and a hut trip for kids, usually held during the January school break.

sources.name: JCC Denver – School's Out Camp
sources.reason: Camps for kindergarten through grade 5, scheduled around Denver Public Schools fall, winter and spring breaks. Each break has its own registration window.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Signature Events
sources.reason: The City of Westminster's official page for its yearly signature events, including Westy Fest and the Holiday Lighting Ceremony at City Hall with Santa, music and food vendors. Check it for the 2026 holiday dates.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Mile High Holidays light displays
sources.reason: A dated 2026–27 list of Denver holiday light shows: Blossoms of Light, Zoo Lights, the Mile High Tree and free nightly drone shows.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Biggest 2026-27 Events in Denver
sources.reason: A month-by-month guide to major Denver events for 2026–27, kept current (updated about a day ago).

sources.name: Downtown Denver Partnership – 9NEWS Parade of Lights
sources.reason: The official page of the group that produces the free yearly holiday parade.

sources.name: Denver Art Museum – SCFD Free Days ticket calendar
sources.reason: A booking calendar for free-day tickets, showing how many spots are left. Advance reservations are recommended.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Thanksgiving Weekend events
sources.reason: Dated free family events for Thanksgiving weekend 2026, like the Union Station tree lighting and the Cherry Creek market.

sources.name: Front Range Community College – Class Schedule FAQs
sources.reason: This official FRCC page is the starting point for finding and signing up for classes at the community college nearest Westminster, which has a Westminster campus. Adults can use it to look up course schedules for future terms. The search tool hit its usage limit after this one result, so other noncredit classes, adult sports leagues, clubs and performance calendars still need to be searched.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools – District Calendar
sources.reason: The official district calendar lists board meetings, public comment sessions and district events. It's useful for families with kids in Adams 12 schools in Westminster, Northglenn and Thornton.

sources.name: Adams County – Events & Public Meetings
sources.reason: The official county calendar lists festivals, community activities and public meetings with upcoming dates in late October 2026, such as a Sheriff's Office (ACSO) Trunk or Treat and several info sessions.

sources.name: Adams County Parks, Open Space & Cultural Arts – Special Events
sources.reason: This page announces the county's yearly signature events at Riverdale Regional Park: Pride, Stars & Stripes, the County Fair, Festival Latino, the Dragon Boat Regatta & Night Market and Welby Days. The 2027 fair dates are already posted.

sources.name: Adams County Health Department – Events Calendar
sources.reason: Recurring free community health events include Shots for Tots & Teens immunization clinics and Baby Café pregnancy support at the Westminster Clinic. There is also help signing up for health coverage.

sources.name: Adams County Fair & Special Events site
sources.reason: This is the official site for the Adams County Fair and the county's special events. It posts daily schedules, Kids Day and Senior Day information, and free entertainment.

events.why: Thanksgiving-week camp at the science museum: $225 for members, $245 for non-members.

events.title: DMNS Winter Break Science Camps (4-day, Dec 28–31)
events.why: Winter-break camp, no camp on January 1. $300 for members, $330 for non-members.

events.title: DMNS Summer Science Camp 2027 (registration opens January)
events.why: Summer camp runs June 1 to August 6, 2027. Registration opens in January 2027, so plan to sign up early.

events.title: Denver Zoo Winter Break Safari Camps (K–4)
events.why: Full-day camp days on Dec 21, 22, 28, 29 and 30, 2026, and January 4, 2027.

events.title: Kent Denver 2027 Summer Camps preview (registration opens Jan 6)
events.why: More than 120 camps for ages 4–18. The 2027 preview comes out November 20, 2026, and registration opens January 6, 2027.

events.title: CSU Spur free Summer 2027 camps – registration opens January
events.why: Free camps. Registration opens in January 2027. Fill out the interest form to get notified.

events.title: Dream Big Day Camp Summer 2027 (PreK–8th, middle and high school programs)
events.why: Denver day camp starting June 7, 2027. Not taking signups yet, so keep an eye out for when enrollment opens.

events.title: i9 Sports Westminster (North) – Sunday Volleyball League Winter 2027
events.why: Youth volleyball for ages 7–14, January 17 to February 28, 2027. The page doesn't say which state, so check that it's Westminster, CO.

events.title: Denver Art Museum SCFD Free Day & Night at the Museums
events.why: Free general admission from 10 AM. Advance reservations are recommended.

events.title: Denver Art Museum SCFD Free Day (December)
events.why: The museum's next free day after November 7.

events.title: Cherry Creek North Holiday Market
events.why: Free holiday market, good for families and dogs, with 50+ local artists and live music. Runs through Dec 24.

events.title: Denver Christkindlmarket (Tivoli Quad, Auraria)
events.why: German-style holiday market with lights, food and music. Runs through Dec 23.

events.title: Mile High Tree & Mile High Drone Shows
events.why: Free nightly 7 PM show with 600 drones, plus the 110-ft lit tree at Auraria. Runs through Dec 31.

events.title: Blossoms of Light – Denver Botanic Gardens
events.why: Ticketed holiday light show. Runs through Jan 10, 2027; closed Nov 26 and Dec 25.

events.title: Zoo Lights – Denver Zoo
events.why: Ticketed light show on select nights. Runs through Jan 3, 2027; closed Nov 26 and Dec 25.

events.title: The Polar Express Train Ride – Colorado Railroad Museum, Golden
events.why: Ticketed train ride where kids meet Santa. Runs most days through Dec 23, with sensory-friendly rides on Dec 7 and 14.

events.title: Hudson Holidays – Hudson Gardens
events.why: Holiday light show with a light tunnel and dancing trees. Runs through Jan 3, 2027.

events.title: Illuminated Christmas Railbike Rides
events.why: Ticketed family railbike ride through holiday lights. Runs through Dec 30.

events.title: Grand Illumination of Union Station
events.why: Free tree lighting, 4–8 PM. The 40-ft tree lights up at 6:10 PM.

events.title: 'A Christmas Carol' – Wolf Theatre, Denver Performing Arts Complex
events.why: Family holiday musical. Runs through Dec 27; tickets required.

events.title: 52nd 9NEWS Parade of Lights
events.why: Free downtown holiday parade with lit floats, giant balloons and Santa.

events.title: 'Granny Dances to Holiday Drum' – Cleo Parker Robinson Dance
events.why: Ticketed dance show celebrating holidays from many cultures, including Chinese New Year. Runs through Dec 20.

events.title: ACSO Trunk or Treat – Clear Creek Valley Park
events.why: A free Halloween trunk-or-treat for kids run by the Adams County Sheriff's Office (ACSO), 4–6 pm, close to Westminster.

events.title: Care Worker Tax Credit Info Session – Human Services Center
events.why: A free county info session for adults about the care worker tax credit.

events.title: 2027 Adams County Fair (Aug 4–8, 2027) – Riverdale Regional Park, Brighton
events.why: These dates were announced far ahead. It's a five-day family fair with a Kids Day, free entertainment, a carnival and 4-H exhibits.

events.title: Adams County Stars & Stripes Independence Day celebration
events.why: Held every year on July 3 at Riverdale Regional Park. It's a free family Fourth of July celebration.
